title: AC1018 TABLE cached string exact-match guard
scope: Reject a generated AC1018 TABLE model when the cached DRW_Variant string differs from the cell text, including differences hidden after an embedded NUL.

finding.before: DRW_Table::encodeDwg compared DRW_Variant::c_str() to the cell text. C-string comparison can stop at an embedded NUL and accept a longer cached value whose suffix would not be emitted.
finding.after: DRW_Variant::stringEquals compares the complete stored UTF8STRING only when the variant type is STRING. The TABLE direct-codec preflight uses this exact comparison.
finding.profile: Generated AC1018 plain-text TABLE direct-codec candidate only; dwgRW::writeTable remains refused.

control.input: In-memory one-cell AC1018 TABLE; cached value is 24 bytes: `retry AC1018 text`, NUL, then `hidden`; emitted cell text is the 17-byte prefix.
control.refusal: Encoder returns false and preserves seeded body and handle destination bytes.
control.retry: After replacing the cached value with the exact cell text, the same TABLE object and destination buffers encode successfully.
control.fixture: No DWG/DXF fixture file was created or committed.

limitations: Generated refusal and retry evidence only; it does not qualify a physical AC1018 TABLE source or native TABLE interoperability.
The AC1018 compound writer remains disconnected from public writeTable pending the physical body, *T graph, outer-transaction, and independent-readback gates.
